headline: Iraqi Prime Minister orders federal takeover of Kurdistan oil exports and border crossings
label: NEWS
caption:
Iraq moves to take control of key economic assets in the northern region 🚨

According to The National and Arab News, Iraqi Prime Minister has ordered a federal takeover of Kurdistan oil exports, border crossings and oilfields in disputed areas.

The Iraqi oil minister has also demanded federal control of northern fields currently held by the Kurdistan region, as part of an anti smuggling drive reaching border crossings.
